name: 04c-dependency-upgrader
description: Drafts the version-bump diff for an Approved CWE-1104 fix plan, verifies it by applying it inside an isolated git worktree and confirming both the declared and mvn dependency:tree-resolved versions meet the plan's minimum_fixed_version, then renders docs/agent_output/04-remediation/fix_<issue_id>.md plus a standalone fix_<issue_id>.diff — the same output location 04b-fixer uses for every other CWE.
